lumia.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to Lumia Stream. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

lumia.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Lumia Stream. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

lumia.chatMessage.description: Runs when Lumia Stream sees a chat message. Handy to react in your lights or overlays.

fields.origin: Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them.

lumia.chatMessageDeleted.description: Runs when Lumia Stream sees a chat message get deleted.

fields.origin: Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them.

lumia.command.description: Runs when a chat command is used that Lumia Stream knows about.

fields.command: Only run for these commands, typed without the ! and separated by commas. Leave empty for any command.
fields.origin: Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them.

lumia.alert.description: Runs when Lumia Stream shows an alert, like a new follower. Good for adding your own reaction.

fields.alert: Only run for these alerts, like "twitch-follower", separated by commas. Leave empty for any alert.
fields.replays: Include runs for every alert. Ignore skips alerts that are being shown again. Only runs just for alerts being shown again.

variables.lumia.replay: True if this alert is shown again
variables.user: Who it was about, if known

lumia.statesChanged.description: Runs when Lumia Stream turns on or off, or its stream mode switches.

variables.lumia.streamMode: True if stream mode is on

lumia.event.description: Runs for other messages Lumia Stream sends that have no trigger of their own.

fields.type: Only run for these kinds of message, like "premium", separated by commas. Leave empty for any.

lumia.sendCommand.description: Tells Lumia Stream to run one of your commands, such as a light show. Handy for stream events.

fields.command: The command's name, as you set it up in Lumia Stream.
fields.commandType: Where the command comes from in Lumia, like a chat command or a channel point reward.
fields.hold: Tick to keep this look until you change it, instead of going back to normal afterwards.
fields.skipQueue: Tick to run right now instead of waiting behind other commands and colours.
fields.extraSettings: Extra details for Lumia, one per line as name=value, like username=%user%. Lumia can use them in its own texts as {{name}}.

lumia.setColor.description: Changes your Lumia Stream lights to a colour. Good for a quick flash when something happens.

fields.color: The colour as #RRGGBB, like #FF0000 for red, or as three numbers like "255,0,0".
fields.brightness: How bright, from 0 to 100. Leave empty to use Lumia's usual setting (100).
fields.duration: How long the colour stays, in milliseconds (1000 is one second). Leave empty to use Lumia's usual (4000).
fields.transition: How long the fade into the colour takes, in milliseconds. Leave empty to use Lumia's usual (0, instant).
fields.default: Tick to put the lights back to normal instead. All other colour settings are ignored.
fields.lights: Only change these lights: type their names separated by commas. Leave empty for all your lights.
fields.hold: Tick to keep this look until you change it, instead of going back to normal afterwards.
fields.skipQueue: Tick to run right now instead of waiting behind other commands and colours.

lumia.setToDefault.description: Puts your Lumia Stream lights back to their normal look.

lumia.sendAlert.description: Makes Lumia Stream show one of its alerts, as if it had really happened. Good for a light show on your own events.

fields.extraSettings: Extra details for Lumia, one per line as name=value, like username=%user%. Lumia can use them in its own texts as {{name}}.

lumia.chatbotMessage.description: Sends a message in chat through Lumia Stream's chat bot.

fields.platform: Which chat to send it to, or all for every chat Lumia is connected to.
fields.asSelf: Tick to send it as you instead of as the bot.

lumia.tts.description: Makes Lumia Stream read a message out loud.

fields.voice: The voice to use. Leave empty for Lumia's normal voice.
fields.volume: How loud, from 0 to 100. Only works on Windows. Leave empty for the normal volume.

lumia.setLumiaState.description: Turns Lumia Stream on or off, or flips it to the other state.

fields.state: On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips whatever it is now.

lumia.setStreamMode.description: Turns Lumia Stream's stream mode on or off, or flips it.

fields.state: On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips whatever it is now.

lumia.getVariable.description: Reads one of Lumia Stream's variables and saves its value in a variable of yours.

fields.name: The Lumia variable to read, like "twitch_username".
fields.argument: The name of your variable that will hold the answer. Use it later as %name%.

variables.lumia.variableValue: The value read from Lumia (or whatever name you chose in the box above)

lumia.setVariable.description: Sets one of Lumia Stream's variables to a value you choose.

fields.name: The name of the Lumia variable to set.
fields.value: The value to put in it.

lumia.send.description: Sends a raw request to Lumia Stream for things the other steps cannot do. For advanced users who know Lumia's request types.

fields.type: The kind of request, as Lumia names it, like "studio-scene" or "clear-queue".
fields.params: The details of the request, written like {"value":"Sunset"}. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.argument: The name of your variable that will hold Lumia's reply.

variables.lumia.response: Lumia's reply (or whatever name you chose in the box above)
